verdicts.summary:
I made the frame flush, like the frame in Linear's Ash and Midnight screens. The old inset sheet (8px margin, rounded, shadow ring) is gone. The main column now runs full height beside the sidebar, and one hairline separates them (a new derived token, --side-edge, so every theme gets it). Every view's top bar now has the same hairline under it, carried out to the sidebar edge (Page .top). Each view's zone (the recess Surface, now marked data-edge) also runs flush out to the sidebar and the window edges and down to the bottom. The ticket split's own border-top is gone because the top bar now draws that line. Views without a flush zone get 16px of room under the bar.

The sidebar is denser and uses Linear's type: 224px wide, 28px rows, 13px medium labels, 12px section titles, 20px between groups. The view counts are now plain muted numbers instead of ringed badges. The theme row at the foot matches the other rows (13px, with the current theme name in 12px muted text).

Themes: Midnight's accent changes from a saturated electric blue (#2563eb) to a blue indigo (#4c5bd4, white text on it 5.6:1), which fixes the clashing Approve button. Group-band tints are toned down in every theme (light band 5.5% to 3.5%, light state tint 6% to 4%, dark state tint 8% to 5%, and the per-theme bands about 25% lighter). The dead tokens are gone: --panel-ring in every theme, the count badge's fill, ring and height, and --shadow-recess. The ledger now describes the flush frame, the bare counts and the flush zone. The kit is 16 lines smaller (8496 to 8480), components 44/45, and budget and raises are unchanged.

I shot every piece to check, and nothing broke. Compact's group bands stop about 10px short of the right edge, and its open row sits as an inset slab. Both belong to the lists piece. Note that the camera writes into a nested frame\frame folder.

verdicts.summary:
The direction follows Linear's Ash theme: neutral bands, rows on hairlines and outlined pill chips.
- Group and zone heads: the per-status band tints are gone. Every group, Agents at work included, now sits on one neutral grey band (--list-band). The status shows only in the head's coloured glyph and its coloured count. The name is ink at weight 500. In dark mode this ends the brown and maroon bars. The tint tokens (--band-*, --band-tint, --list-band-ink) and Head's data-tone rules are deleted.
- Rows: Row line is now a flat row running edge to edge on a hairline, as in Linear's list, 42px tall instead of 40. The hover and open wash fill the whole width instead of a rounded slab held in from the edges.
- Chips: inside a list row or an agent tile, a label chip is a pill on a hairline with no fill. This is scoped by the row's data-row attribute and the tile's data-look="agent", so chips on other screens are unchanged. Keycaps pick up the same hairline.
- Agents at work: running and queued tiles now look the same, the surface on a hairline using the existing --tile tokens. The dashed card and the grey slab are both gone, so the dashed glyph alone says queued. The owner's face has moved out of the pill and is drawn at row size (18px), which fixes the 6px initials. The pill keeps the agent's words and its glyph on the live disc. Card's agent `off` prop is removed.
- Retry: the ink button is now the default white fill with a firmer edge and weight, so it matches the Request changes buttons next to it. The unused --ctl-strong tokens are deleted.
- Stepper: --tk-skip was only defined for the light themes, so in dark mode the skipped Lint stage drew an empty segment. The token moved to the block every theme shares, and the dashes now show in dark.
- Ledger entries for Head tone, Row line, Chip (why, line, fill), Card (off, agent look) and Button ink are updated to match. Kit lines went from 8,496 to 8,458 (net -38). Components stay at 44 of 45. Budget and raises are untouched.

Each saved query is a flush section with a quiet group head: project key, bold name, muted count and a chevron after the words, like the sidebar's section caret. The head has no fill, a hairline under it, and stays at the top while its rows scroll past. Sections are kept apart by 24px of space instead of borders. Each issue row now follows the Triage layout: title (weight 500) at top left with the Jira key link across from it at top right; the line under it has an 18px face before the assignee's name (a small dashed ring for Unassigned) and one fact, with the age across from it. Take in still replaces the age on hover or focus. The big leading avatar column is gone, which fixes the large faint dashed circles. The "1 didn't answer · checked 2m ago" line moved into the list's foot bar, pinned to the bottom of the sheet, so it no longer hangs loose. The failed query and the empty query now start where the row titles start, each with its glyph in front (a blocked dot, an empty ring). Kit changes: Surface level "list" is now a flush section with no card; Head level "line" is restyled as above; Notice align "item" is rewritten; Stack gains align="end" for the key-over-age cell. Two tokens that nothing uses now (--list-card-head, --notice-slot) and Notice's status align "end" are removed. The ledger is updated to match, including Avatar's talk/dashed reasons. Kit size goes from 8,496 to 8,480 lines (-16), still 44/45 components.

verdicts.summary:
This challenger rebuilds All teams as a Linear board grouped by team. It has four stage columns and a swimlane for each repo, and the team column is gone, so the cards get the width.
- Swimlane head: each repo's band starts with one line across the whole board. It shows the repo name (14px, 600), its full name, the team faces in their own colours, "N in flight" (or "Nothing in flight"), and a quiet "Open list" button with an icon at the right edge. This replaces the low-weight "Open list →" link text.
- Lanes: under the head, each stage's lane is a faint rounded slab (new token --teams-lane, mixed from ink), so the stages read as columns down the board. A stage that is empty across the whole board (Verify) folds to a narrow 112px lane.
- docs: a repo with nothing in flight is its head line alone, so the stray underlined "Nothing in flight" cell is gone.
- Cards are two tight lines, about 60px each instead of about 90px. The first line has the key, with the state pill right-aligned at its end. The second has the status glyph and the title.
- Pills use a new Chip tone "edge": a round outlined pill, Linear's card pill. Each pill now has a dot in its state's colour (red for Blocked, indigo for your move, grey for Queued and waiting), so the pills carry colour in dark mode. A running card's pill shows the agent's glyph on its orange disc and the owner's face, like Linear's "Working…" pill.
- Dark cards sit a step above their lane: --teams-card is now 7% wash instead of 4%.
- Header counters: the lone "|" divider is removed and "need you" comes first.
- Kit: Row's band now takes a leading head cell that spans every column (the useCells lead offset, plus the band CSS rewritten). Avatar size "mid" was used only by the old team column, so I removed it, along with the unused --teams-card-hover and --h-band tokens. I updated the ledger entries (Chip tone, Avatar size, Card ticket look, Row band) and exported ChipDot. The kit is net -2 lines.

The ticket page now follows the layout of Linear's project page.
- Properties moved out of the rail. They sit under the title and lead as three labelled rows (Properties, Code, Workflow), the same head the peek already draws. The rail now holds only Talk, so the whole thread fits above the composer.

The active tab is ink-1 on a 2px ink underline, and the rest are ink-3 until hovered. 'Overview' no longer sits clipped against the left edge. The same kit change applies to the workflow editor's Library tabs; I checked them and they render cleanly.
- The run card's "now" row is now a footer across the card's full width, on the faint well tint the rail uses. The run reads as the card's status bar.

verdicts.summary:
Direction: one family of sheets lifted over a scrim, and one aligned left edge in place of boxes. The full-window item editor is now a centred document, like Linear's project page.
- Peek (kit Dialog side look): no longer docked to the edge. It floats inset by --sp-4 with rounded corners and the float shadow, over the same --tk-scrim as the full overlays, so the queue is dimmed (the veil is gone). The bar and foot have no rules. The scrolling body fades out under both (a mask), so the last bubble fades into the composer instead of being cut by a border. Open ticket, the menu and close are now three bordered sm controls of one kind.
- Full overlays (Dialog full): the close moved from a left column with a vertical rule to a bordered square at the bar's end, where the peek's is. The Page top bar leaves room for it through a --top-end custom property. The dialog now opens focused on itself (autofocus before showModal), so no "Close (Esc)" tooltip appears on open.
- Item overlay / ItemEditor: the right rail is gone. Page side look "rail" is replaced by "doc": the body is one centred reading column. It has a display title (a new read-only heading prop; the overlay passes the item's name, e.g. AGENTS.md), then Linear-style labelled property rows built on the kit Facts component (Properties, Used by, History), then the blocks, all on one left edge. Values are one size; links in a Facts chip inherit its size. Block bodies read as document text in Geist 14px with an edge only on hover or focus. The drag handles hang in the margin. Blocked quiet icon buttons (the up/down chevrons) fade instead of drawing dashed boxes.
- Workflow overlay (dark): the loop's filled wash is now a quiet bracket in the gutter, drawn in the lane-axis colour, so nothing is boxed. The drift banner ("This copy") and "Every stage gets" are FormRows with one label column. Prompt lines use ink-2. The struck-through override word ('high' in 'xhigh high') is in ink-2 with a thin muted strike, so it's easier to read.
- Unused tokens removed: --tk-veil, --shadow-dock, --w-rail, --loop-fill. Ledger entries updated for Page.side.look (column/doc), Dialog looks, Facts and TextArea.bare. Kit: 8496 to 8506 lines (+10), still 44 components, at most 8 props each.
- Side effects outside this piece: the library's own item editors (agent, skill, file) also take the document layout, because they share ItemEditor and side.tsx. The Lane bracket also shows on the ticket's read-only Workflow tab.

verdicts.summary:
Explore direction "two-line ledger", modelled on Linear's project rows. The library lists change from one-line rows to roomy two-line items on hairlines (Row kind="item"), running edge to edge.
- Every row now opens with a 32px rounded-square tile of the same shape and size on all four pages: a neutral glyph tile with a hairline ring for workflows, skills and files, and a tile in the agent's own hue with legible 12px initials for agents (new Avatar size "tile", new token --h-tile).
- NameCell puts the name (14px medium) on the first line and a second line under it: the description for skills and agents (agent descriptions were not shown before), the file's opening line or AGENTS.md's block names for files, and the stage strip with its words for workflows. The default chip stays beside the name, and a workflow's description shows on hover.
- The primary column takes all the free width. The metadata columns sit together on the right: Workflows lose the separate fill Stages column, and Agents narrow Runtime to md and Model and Effort to sm. This removes the gaps of roughly 300px and 600px the critic flagged.
- The faint head band is gone: the head is now plain labels between two rules, spaced to line up with the item rows.
- The strip's loop bracket is now 2px (it was 1.5px) and sits further below the segments.
- In the Changed column the face goes from 18px to 24px (size "talk"), so initials like BQ and CR can be read.
- Kit is 8505 lines (+9 net), still 44/45 components; ledger entries updated for Avatar size, Icon tile, Table edge and Row item.
- Not addressed: the dark-mode sheet edge (that is the frame's piece) and the blank canvas below short lists. The taller rows and the closing hairline under the last row only partly help with the blank canvas.

verdicts.summary:
This challenger restyles the editors as framed sheets with a single primary button.
- Item editors (agent, skill, file): the content now sits in a framed sheet: a hairline edge, a head strip ruled off over the text, and the pop-out moved into the head. The edge firms on hover and gets an accent ring while the text has focus. The agent's instructions sheet runs to the bottom of the column, so you can see where the editable area ends.
- Each AGENTS.md block is a sheet of its own. Its head reads fold caret, name heading, line count, then the up/down pair. A folded block shows its first line in the head (TextArea's `bare` prop is replaced by `head` and `folded`).
- Bar buttons: Save is always the filled accent (`you`) button, faded while there is nothing to save. Discard, Undo and Redo are quiet. A blocked quiet button is now just its faded glyph or words, with no dashed box. This fixes the boxed disabled chevrons in the sibling nav and the block moves.
- The file title is set in the headings' sans instead of bold monospace (`name.mono` is removed).
- Properties rail: Tickets puts the count on its own line and the first two keys plus +N on one line under it, so nothing wraps raggedly.
- Workflow lane: each stage is a flat hairline card over the axis, which shows only in the joints, so stages inside the loop band are clearly apart in dark mode. A disabled stage gets a dashed edge, the fade is raised from 0.55 to 0.72, and 'Skipped' is in tone 2.
- The ticket's read-only Workflow tab and the item overlay pick up the same look; I checked both in screenshots.
- Kit grows by 59 lines (8,496 to 8,555). The ledger entries for Button you/quiet, Card stage, Field title/heading and TextArea head/folded are updated.

verdicts.summary:
Direction: the filter becomes one control, and every popover uses the page's body text size.
- Filter chips (Segmented): the chips are now segments of a single recessed track. The track has a faint ink fill, is rounded at its two ends and is 34px tall, so it lines up with the bar's search field and New ticket button. The pressed chip is a raised control inside the track, inset 3px, using the button's fill, a lit hairline and a small drop. The other chips are secondary text; hover shows an inset wash. The state glyphs (Needs you, Blocked, Running) now keep their state colours, as the list's group heads draw them. The "+N" overflow chip is the track's last segment. This answers the critic's note that only 'Everything' was boxed and the filter had no edge.
- Popovers (menu, owner picker, theme menu, filter overflow): text goes from 13px to 14px, the body size (--fs-tk); rows go from 32px to 34px; the filter field is 44px at 14px; the sheet padding is 6px and the corners are 12px. Rows use the body ink and brighten to ink-1 when highlighted. The picker sheet widens from 220px to 248px, and the theme menu from 272px to 304px so "Midnight" isn't cut off. This answers the notes that the menu text looked smaller and lighter than the page and that the owner picker was cramped.
- Toasts: title at 14px, note at 13px, matching the popovers.
- Not addressed: the owner picker still opens over the Talk header and hides its subtitle and avatars. The popover anchoring is unchanged.
- Ledger: the Segmented 'why' and the mark prop's 'why' are updated to describe the track and the coloured glyphs. "budget" and "raises" are untouched. Kit: +14 lines net (8,496 to 8,510 of 9,000), still 44/45 components.
- Files changed: tokens.css, Segmented.module.css, Popover.module.css, Menu.module.css, Toast.module.css, ledger.json.
- Spot checks outside my piece: the frame's theme menu and the workflow overlay look fine.
- The camera writes into a <piece> subfolder, so the shots landed in r2\cand\controls\controls\.
